rows.note: Use 唔小心 as the all-purpose everyday choice when an action is done without enough care or attention.

example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 zo2 zek3 bui1

rows.note: Use 求其 when the manner is casual, unconcerned, or haphazard rather than specifically inattentive.

example.english: We carelessly grabbed something to eat and called it a day.
example.traditional: 我哋求其食啲嘢就算喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kau4 kei4 sik6 di1 je5 zau6 syun3 laa3
